name: Secretaría de Cultura, Recreación y Deporte
body: nosniff, a strict Referrer-Policy, framing limited to its origin, a canonical, and language alternates that link back. But beside GA4 the page still loads UA-3599876-14, which has collected nothing since July 2024.
lesson: Remove the old UA tag and keep one GA4 setup, so pages stop loading code that sends data nowhere.
summary: www.culturarecreacionydeporte.gov.co scores 77 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 25 are at risk, and 14 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 126 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Universal Analytics code is still on the page
fix.evidence: Google stopped processing Universal Analytics data in July 2024. The code adds weight and collects nothing.
fix.fix: Remove the UA- tag and keep GA4.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Analytics 4, Universal Analytics appear in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.
